difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is locally of finite type as soon as its base change along a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the target by an algebraic space is (author lemma at source lines 3553-3559, label lemma-check-finite-type-covering). The proof (source lines 3562-3583) chooses smooth scheme covers, base changes the whole setup along the given cover so that the hypothesis applies to a morphism of schemes, and then descends the property along the surjective flat cover of finite presentation (proof lines 3563-3582). The two reductions, to schemes and back along the descent, are the content. H2.
